thread:
hannah: quick async pulse: where are we on the kernel micro-optimizations that feed continuous batching? need a short list of blockers + owner so i can update product/pm 
vik: working through the kernel PR diffs, main blocker is the header lock during KV attach. i pushed a draft fix but it regresses p95 on long sequences locally :/ 
marco: @vik can you paste the perf diff and which test harness? also pinging @sara for KV cache warmup overlap — we saw bursty misses on canary yesterday. 
sara: canary showed ~10% cold miss spike at 2am — prob from the prefetch window shrinking after the auto-scale event. owner for warmup tuning is me, but i need a config change approved (ttl->120s)
lee: (ops-bot) deploy: canary rollout 2026-03-01T09:12Z succeeded on 3/5 nodes, 2 nodes failed with OOM. logs: "kv_cache_reclaim: triggered"
hannah: thanks. can we get a matrix: PR|owner|blocker|next-step | ETA? short entries pls. i'll stitch into the milestone doc.
vik: PR#4217 | vik | header lock regression (race w/ attach) | bisect kernel small-lock -> try lock striping, running microbench 2h | EOD tuesday
marco: PR#4199 | marco | microbatch path not using KV fast-path for <64 tokens | add conditional fast-path and unit tests, request review from @vik | mid-week
sara: warmup-config (infra) | sara | TTL and prefetch window too small after autoscale | propose TTL=120 & prefetch=2s -> staging canary tomorrow morning | tomorrow AM
lee: infra ticket INF-982 | lee | nodes evicting caches under OOM pressure during heavy concurrent sessions | diag: cgroup mem spikes from background GC, need memory guard and limit tune | start by adding a soft limit in node-launch config, target Wednesday
hannah: love it. two quick asks: 1) @vik can you post the exact perf numbers (p50/p95) after lock striping attempt in this thread, 2) @sara please TL;DR staging canary results here after you run it
vik: will run the microbench tonight and paste numbers by morning 
sara: staging canary scheduled 07:30 PT, i'll report results here. if positive, i'll open PROD rollout PR and tag @lee for infra tweak
marco: also small follow-up: codeowners on microbatch path -> i'm going to add @vik and @sara so reviews are faster
hannah: perfect. i'll mark owners in the milestone doc and flag any cross-team blockers to product. ping me if any ETA slips. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: (incident-bot) reminder: next downtime window Thu 02:00-03:00 UTC for kernel mmap maintenance
hannah: noted, thanks bot. if we need to avoid that window for a canary i can reschedule.
vik: quick heads up — if lock striping doesn't pass, fallback plan is to bypass header attach for seq<32 (fast-path degrade) — not ideal but safe. i'll call it out in PR description.
sara: staging canary finished: cold miss spike reduced to 2.1% (from 10%), no OOMs. will open rollout PR now.
hannah: excellent. closing this async thread — i'll post the updated milestone doc link when i'm done.
marco: thanks all.
